label: The review reducer projects a per-node visits count but the research reducer drops it, so the research dashboard can print a revision total but not per-node detail even though frontierNodeVisits is already defined beside the projection.

The frontier dashboard section has drifted between the reducers: review renders 10B with an active-node line, research renders 6B without one, so a shared renderFrontierDashboardSection helper should own both.

The two reducers live in different trees and this study's own scope line names a nonexistent deep-review/scripts/reduce-state.cjs, so moving the research reducer to runtime/scripts would erase a wrong path from the operating model.
